headline: Nestle Nigeria Appoints New Communications Lead for Reputation and Sustainability
summary: Nestle Nigeria has appointed Toritseju Egbebi as its new head of corporate communications to lead its reputation and sustainability agenda, succeeding retiring executive Victoria Uwadoka.
why: Nestle Nigeria is a publicly traded subsidiary of Nestle SA, one of the world's largest food and beverage companies, making corporate leadership changes relevant for regional stakeholders.

impacts.name: Nestlé Nigeria
impacts.why: Management changes affect corporate communications and sustainability strategy.
